scope: Fixed membership S2348, S2382, S2506, S2631, S3025 only
modelNote: The skill-default GPT-5.5 runner was not selectable in this delegated workspace; the available local GPT-5 Codex model was used.

preApply.protectedScreening: Each record has two immutable full-text include votes, a ready_for_extraction resolution, and a promotion link. No screening-record, vote, resolution, promotion, or file write is staged.

checks: Each attached primary PDF was inspected in full once; every local SHA-256 matches papers.primary_file_sha256.

The strongest directly reported population split was checked for each source. S2382 has one defensible `Total` row because its 13/22 low-energy-availability-risk outcome is pooled; its national/U20 membership split is descriptive only and does not carry separately reported outcome values. The other four records have no extraction population.

Tabs 1-4 and all results tables, figures, discussion, and conclusions were swept for compatible injury/illness numerator, denominator, incidence, burden, severity, recurrence, mechanism, diagnosis, location, tissue/type, and illness metrics. S2382 supports the direct metabolic/nutritional illness-risk fields below; the other four do not support a Tabs 1-10 payload.
S2348 is a 10-page 766-person COVID-19 vaccination and State-Trait Anxiety Inventory survey; injury appears only as a questionnaire exclusion criterion.

S2382 is an 8-page 22-player questionnaire study of low energy availability, eating-disorder risk, sleep, nutrition knowledge, mood, and menstrual disturbance. Its directly reported LEAF-Q screen identifies 13/22 players (59.1%) at risk of problematic low energy availability; this is a compatible metabolic/nutritional illness-risk outcome, not an injury-surveillance outcome.

S2506 is a 16-page 18-player U16 four-match well-being questionnaire study. Its figures and analyses report muscle soreness, stress, mood, fatigue, sleep, and a wellness index; injury appears only as background/risk context, never as an outcome.

S2631 is a 13-page PRISMA-ScR scoping review that screened literature and synthesized 72 articles, rather than reporting a single player cohort. Its live exclusion is corrected from mental_health to systematic_review.
S3025 is an 8-page 52-player competitive-anxiety questionnaire study by playing position; all results are SCAT/CSAI-2 anxiety and self-confidence scores, not injury or illness outcomes.

S2382 uses supported study, participant, definition, and metabolic/nutritional illness field IDs. Its single `Total` population value rows are dual-written from the same one-line extraction fields. No fields, structured rows, or populations are staged for the other four exclusions.
